AUTH_CHANNEL.binding_contract: Source channel name. Preserve source case unless a reviewed namespace-specific canonicalization is required; apply matching normalization on both join sides. Unknown keys must be null, not empty or a shared placeholder.

AUTH_EVENT_UID.binding_contract: Collision-free source event key including target/provider/channel/record generation; deduplicate only repeated delivery of the same event. Preserve source case unless a reviewed namespace-specific canonicalization is required; apply matching normalization on both join sides. Unknown keys must be null, not empty or a shared placeholder.

AUTH_LOGON_KEY.binding_contract: Target endpoint boot/LSA epoch plus TargetLogonId; never a Terminal Services session ID without proven mapping. Preserve source case unless a reviewed namespace-specific canonicalization is required; apply matching normalization on both join sides. Unknown keys must be null, not empty or a shared placeholder.

AUTH_LOGON_TYPE.binding_contract: Parsed numeric EventData.LogonType; null for absent/invalid.

AUTH_PROVIDER.binding_contract: Source provider name. Preserve source case unless a reviewed namespace-specific canonicalization is required; apply matching normalization on both join sides. Unknown keys must be null, not empty or a shared placeholder.

AUTH_SOURCE_IP.binding_contract: Canonical client IP; preserve IPv4/IPv6; map absent, dash and unresolved placeholders to null, document gateways/NAT. Preserve source case unless a reviewed namespace-specific canonicalization is required; apply matching normalization on both join sides. Unknown keys must be null, not empty or a shared placeholder.

AUTH_TARGET_ACCOUNT_KEY.binding_contract: Domain-qualified stable target account or SID; not the Subject account. Preserve source case unless a reviewed namespace-specific canonicalization is required; apply matching normalization on both join sides. Unknown keys must be null, not empty or a shared placeholder.

AUTH_TARGET_ENDPOINT.binding_contract: Stable destination endpoint identity valid at event time. Preserve source case unless a reviewed namespace-specific canonicalization is required; apply matching normalization on both join sides. Unknown keys must be null, not empty or a shared placeholder.

AUTH_TIME.binding_contract: Source event time, UTC datetime; not collector receipt time.

POWERSHELL_BEHAVIOR_RE2.binding_contract: Explicit tested whole-command behavior grammar, e.g. the strict encoded-command grammar in N021. Must include argv0/argument semantics; not a bare PowerShell name or substring. This query uses case_sensitive=true; use tested scoped RE2 case-insensitive groups only for Windows executable/PowerShell keyword tokens that are case-insensitive, retaining argument/path case when significant.

RDP_PROCESS_OPERATION.binding_contract: Canonical process_start only when the source event is a start, not generic process-category context.
